definitions.explanation: The point in time at exactly 0:00, the start of a new day. Used in formal time-telling and schedules.

examples.japanese: {零時|れいじ}ちょうどに{新年|しんねん}のカウントダウンが{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: The New Year's countdown begins at exactly midnight.

examples.japanese: セールは{零時|れいじ}から{開始|かいし}されるので、{夜更|よふ}かしして{待|ま}っていた。
examples.english: The sale starts at midnight, so I stayed up late waiting.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in formal contexts, schedules, and when specifying exact times. In casual speech, {夜中|よなか}の{十二時|じゅうにじ} (12 o'clock at night) is more common.

RELATED TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- {午前零時|ごぜんれいじ} (0:00 AM — formal/official)
- {正午|しょうご} (noon — 12:00 PM)
- {深夜|しんや} (late at night — less precise than {零時|れいじ})

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {零時|れいじ}を{回|まわ}る (to pass midnight)
- {午前|ごぜん}{零時|れいじ} (12:00 AM)
- {零時|れいじ}{過|す}ぎ (just after midnight)
